overview_description.description: Rank (formerly Moni or Moni Africa) is a fintech company headquartered in Lagos, Nigeria. It operates a community-powered money application designed to help individuals and small businesses save, borrow, spend, and manage money. The company is licensed by the Central Bank of Nigeria (CBN) and operates through two regulated entities: Rank Microfinance Bank and Rank Capital Limited.

about_short_description.short_description: Rank, formerly Moni, is a money app for communities built to make prosperity common; Powered by Rank Microfinance Bank & Rank Capital

product.name: Moni Loans
product.description: Provides flexible loans to merchants and SMEs with community-based group financing and competitive interest rates.

product.name: Moni Savings
product.description: Allows users to create multiple savings plans with high-interest rates to build savings discipline and meet financial goals.

product.name: Moni Insurance
product.description: Offers cash insurance policies customized for businesses to protect against losses, with instant mobile claim filing and cashback.

product.name: Moni Rent Payment
product.description: Covers 100% of a user's rent upfront, allowing them to pay back monthly without requiring co-signers or collateral.

product.name: Moni for Operators
product.description: Provides fast capital and financial services tailored for point-of-sale (POS) operators to support their business needs.

product.name: Money Circles
product.description: A community savings product that digitizes rotating savings groups, offering zero-interest lump-sum payouts with a fixed service fee and guaranteed payouts.
